business_problem: give sales teams timely, AI-assisted customer intelligence instead of forcing reps to spend hours searching across disconnected data before outreach and account reviews.
solution_summary: Intercom uses Snowflake, Cortex AI, and Cortex Search on Snowflake to give sales teams timely, ai-assisted customer intelligence instead of forcing reps to spend hours searching across disconnected data before outreach and account reviews. Customer behavior, profile, and sentiment data are consolidated in Snowflake so Intercom can build a unified Sales Cockpit for account research and planning. Cortex AI and Cortex Search analyze and retrieve the relevant context needed for personalized outbound research, account summaries, and customer insight decks. Sales reps consume the outputs through the Cockpit and agent-driven workflows that surface who to contact, what to say, and which customer issues or opportunities matter most. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI. Intercom cut customer insight report generation by 96%,...

solution_components.name: Cortex AI

solution_components.name: Cortex Search
